create_OutOfGraphPrioritizedReplayMemory: create an OutOfGraphPrioritizedReplayMemory instance with num_actions, observation_size, stack_size, replay_capacity, and batch_size
add_transition_replay_memory: add a transition with observation, action, reward, terminal, and legal_actions to the prioritized replay memory
sample_index_batch: sample a batch of valid indices from the prioritized replay memory using the sum tree
set_priority: set priorities for given memory indices based on computed losses
tf_set_priority: create a TensorFlow op to set priorities for replay memory indices within a graph
